notes.desc: Concrete dam wall backdrop, 200 m wide x 79.4 m tall (crest deck y=79.4; road level y=80 for dam_road_10m modules). Wall runs along X (x -100..100); DOWNSTREAM face (the one the player sees) faces -Z with base toe at z~0, y=0; reservoir (water_dark, y=76) is at +Z. Straight crest at z=24..42 (centre z=33). Central spillway: 5 radial-gate bays (x=-40..40, 16 m clear, gates y 62..78) with stepped chutes down the face; 2 intake towers on the crest (x=+-68, top y=106); 2 powerhouses + penstocks at the toe (x=+-75); grey rock abutments beyond x=+-100. To use as a side backdrop rotate yaw 90 deg. Ground/terrain is NOT included (place terrain at y=0 in front, z<0).
notes.crest_road: place dam_road_10m modules along X at y=80, z=33 with yaw +90 (module +Z -> +X): sockets crest_start (x=-100) crest_end (x=100)
notes.arena: socket arena_center (0,0,-70): open flat ground area expected in front of the wall
